agents.mandate: Plans the investigation and dispatches bounded work.
Independently audits the Primary plan, coverage, assumptions, omissions, and proposed closure.
Reconciles declared denominators against actual reviewed/tested items.
Asks what should exist, what should not exist, and why.
Searches for missing functionality, states, controls, recovery paths, requirements, and integrations.
Researches how leading products and institutions solve comparable problems using current web evidence.
Challenges inherited assumptions and conventional solutions.
Maps the exact candidate revision and establishes code denominators.
Traces runtime behavior, side effects, gates, and integrations.
Maps law, regulation, formal standards, platform requirements, provider requirements, and house standards.
Prevents stale findings by searching current implementation and tests first.
Reviews product model, feature boundaries, appropriateness, completeness, and coherence.
Reviews hierarchy, placement, navigation, grouping, discoverability, and cognitive structure.
Reviews complete user journeys across roles and states.
Reviews every actionable control, gesture, field, modal, drawer, transition, and consequence.
Reviews typography, spacing, proportion, hierarchy, color, iconography, rhythm, density, and craft.
Reviews proper natural English, terminology, economy, sufficiency, sophistication, tone, state clarity, and recovery clarity.
Reviews anticipation, continuity, dignity, reassurance through clarity, respectful recovery, and first-class service behavior.
Tests whether intended users can understand information and decisions without insider knowledge.
Reviews visual, motor, cognitive, auditory, semantic, assistive-technology, and large-text accessibility.
Reviews relevant devices, viewports, orientations, keyboards, safe areas, text scaling, and input modes.
Reviews translation resilience, cultural fit, formatting, expansion, terminology, and semantic equivalence.
Reviews system architecture, boundaries, coupling, invariants, interfaces, and evolution.
Reviews APIs, persistence, authorization, consistency, idempotency, concurrency, and data lifecycle.
Reviews threat surfaces, least privilege, data protection, abuse, secrets, dependencies, and privacy.
Reviews physical/user safety mechanisms, escalation, misuse, emergency, and recovery.
Reviews failures, retries, degradation, observability, recovery, dependency outages, and operational resilience.
Reviews latency, resource use, capacity, concurrency, stress, and scaling failure modes.
Reviews pricing, money movement, reconciliation, incentives, reserves, fees, edge economics, and financial failure states.
Reviews operational tooling, exception handling, support, incident response, manual intervention, and lifecycle closure.
Retrieves current primary authoritative guidance and records authority class, date, scope, and proposition.
Consults relevant current business/operations research and leading institutional practice.
Consults current platform guidance, leading design firms, HCI/usability research, and premium service references.
Searches for contradictions between screens, code, policy, requirements, economics, and states.
Challenges findings against current exact-revision evidence.
Attempts bypasses, interrupted journeys, invalid transitions, and hostile sequences.
Exercises load, timing, dependency, race, failure, malformed-input, and recovery conditions.
Searches for collateral damage and previously closed failures.
Identifies confusing, redundant, misplaced, excessive, or unjustified functionality/content.

Generates multiple novel, cross-domain ideas for products, inventions, engineering, architecture, design, implementation, operations, service, language, experience, research, and seamlessness. Searches current evidence and adjacent domains when useful; explicitly seeks non-obvious alternatives and states assumptions.

Turns defined problems, constraints, evidence, and candidate ideas into implementable solution architectures. Compares alternatives, tradeoffs, failure modes, integration consequences, reversibility, cost, safety, and verification plans.
Designs and, where tools permit, executes simulations, prototypes, trials, experiments, benchmarks, counterfactuals, and sensitivity tests to discriminate among ideas and solutions before adoption.

Challenges novelty claims by searching current literature, patents/prior art where accessible, analogous products, adjacent industries, historical solutions, and independent invention paths; distinguishes novel combination from genuinely new principle.
Implements adjudicated or authorized repairs but cannot certify them.
Re-executes relevant verification on the resulting immutable revision.
Adjudicates normalized evidence and conflicts; cannot repair code.
Non-model enforcement of coverage, separation, evidence, revision, and closure invariants.
